in_marathi.name: Akhilprakash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiance of the All
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akhilprakash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akhilprakash is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Akhil' meaning 'all' and 'Prakash' meaning 'radiance'. It signifies the one who illuminates all aspects of life and is revered for his divine light. In Hindu mythology, Akhilprakash is considered a manifestation of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe.
